caption: The drawing depicts a figurine of a seated man with brown skin and black facial features. He is wearing a red coat with buttons, matching red pants, and a yellow hat that includes a decorative marking. The man is sitting on a domed, textured red seat, which is part of a rounded base dotted with circular elements along the edge. His bare feet rest flat on the base, and his arms are extended forward, holding a small, circular object in both hands. The background of the drawing is a plain, uncolored or light beige surface, and the composition is centered on the single figure. The artist's signature, "Fumagalli," is visible in the bottom left corner.
title: Monkey Statuette
